reuse.why: The new action takes its categories from the existing getMonthFillCategories and its sign from averageToBudgetAmount, and reads spending through getSheetValue like the average actions.

duplication.why: No logic is copied; the action is a short loop over the shared selection and amount helpers.

placement.why: The action sits in budget/actions.ts with the other month-wide actions and is registered in budget/app.ts next to them with mutator(undoable(...)).

scope.why: Only the new action, its registration and tests (including one more created month in the fixture) are touched.

maintainability.why: Any future change to which categories month-wide actions fill or to the budget sign automatically applies to the new action.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Uses getMonthFillCategories('visible') and averageToBudgetAmount instead of its own query or sign logic.
